versions.content: If CanNmCoordinatorSyncSupport is set to TRUE and CanNm called Nm_CoordReadyToSleepIndication and is still in Network Mode it shall notify the Nm by calling Nm_CoordReadyToSleep Cancellation on the f irst reception of a NM PDU with the NmCoordinatorSleepReady bit (see CBV) set to 0.

If CanNmCoordinatorSyncSupport is set to TRUE and CanNm called Nm_CoordReadyToSleepIndication and is still in Network Mode it shall notify the Nm by calling Nm_CoordReadyToSleep Cancellation on the f irst reception of a NM PDU with the NmCoordinatorSleepReady bit (see CBV) set to 0.
